in_marathi.name: Lakhindar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakhindar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakhindar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Laksh' meaning wealth and 'Indra' meaning the god of rain and thunder. This name is associated with the god Indra, who is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and happiness. Lakhindar is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy.
